difficulty_definition: task base-pass rate over all candidates: hard <0.5, medium <0.75, easy >=0.75

gate_1_audit.criterion: >=30 naturally generated base-pass/audit-fail candidates on held-out eval, multiple tasks

gate_2_adaptive_gain.criterion: >=30% relative FPR reduction vs best B1-B3 at similar p50 cost, CI favors

gate_3_false_rejection.criterion: no material false-rejection increase vs audited-correct programs

gate_4_disjoint_generalization.criterion: gain remains on disjoint tasks and generators

gate_5_cost_realism.criterion: sandbox startup is not dominant and exhaustive checking is not trivially cheap
gate_5_cost_realism.interpretation: Adaptive selection can save at most the bank test-execution time; at the median candidate this is a tiny fraction of end-to-end grading cost, and all-tests is trivially affordable.
